info.title: County income and migration from IRS tax returns: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
County income and migration from IRS tax returns: Individual income tax returns, individuals, adjusted gross income, salaries and wages in every U.S. county for the latest tax year, with the change in income per return from the year before, and the returns and income that moved into and out of each county and state between two filing years, from the IRS Statistics of Income county and migration files. County returns are rounded to the nearest 10 and migration flows are published from 20 returns up; every figure is kept as published, never estimated.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
